title: Podkletnov's father retrieved Schauberger's files

tellings.quote: Schauberger cuz his dad was actually a Soviet agent that retrieved Victor Schauberger's files.

plain: The father of a scientist named Eugene Podkletnov is said to have been a Soviet agent who, in the 1940s, collected the files of a man named Viktor Schauberger. Michels says this himself, without naming a source: "his dad was actually a Soviet agent that retrieved Victor Schauberger's files." If true, it would link Podkletnov's own work to Schauberger's papers through his family.
